items.text:
<Reliable Raiders> PC/NA/All Alliances Vet DLC HM focused Guild, Skip the Pugfest!
 **<Reliable Raiders>** Is looking for more players to join our team.

​

We are focused on vet dlc hm content for **achievements/gear/titles/skins.** We also schedule and run **vBRP and vDSA.**

​

**CP 300+ Required.**

​

**A DPS parse of at least 30K is required to move up in guild rank and to be certified as a "Raider."**

**Appropriate Gear/skills/ultis for Tanks and Healers will also be identified for certification.**

​

We have **50** active members and we use **Discord** for comms, info, and sign up requests for specific dungeons.

​

Contact **@alarik83** for more info and inv. Thanks!
Sure!
I want that helmet.
Kotaku is a joke.

Thank you so much for replying. I do not own a heating pad nor a laptop. I do prefer very hard beds, however.... I had been sleeping on an air mattress for over 2 years (slept wonderfully on it) but it recently deflated so I had to start sleeping on my futon which doubles as a bed and has an extra layer of cushioning which is very soft..... In saying that, sleeping on soft beds tend to send a sharp burning/itching pain/electricity to my right thigh like some sort of sciatica issue. It does not often occur while on soft beds but it does every now and then. It will wake me up in the middle of the night.

HOLY SHIT. Sir or ma'am! I think you may be correct on the **erythema ab igne**. I looked it up and it states that **prolonged exposure** to thermal radiation such as **SPACE HEATERS** may cause this. Right next to my computer, I have a space heater that sits on my left side (which is where this is occurring, on my left arm). When I go to sleep at night, I will bring the space heater into my room and place it on my left side. I am looking at pictures of other people with erythema ab igne and it looks very similar. Holy smokes, thank you very much! **My last question would be, will this go away or am I now scarred for life with this? Thank you soo much!**
Thank you so much for sharing your experience! How crazy!
Thank you so much for replying! I thought and my gf thought it was linked to the supplement I was taking! lol
Thank you for your help! Very much appreciated.
Sure just give me a message, we need you guys at 300CP to participate in vet stuff but I'll make a few exceptions. Message me when you can in game, thanks or send mail to me.

Back in the old days vampires were unkillible in PVP. I remember 40 people trying to kill one vamp. I also remember how shield bash was super OP. I miss my first guild, Blood of the North and everyone that was in the guild.

The Palestinians will be treated as second class citizens and or subhuman. There are many Palestinians that have been in Jordan and Lebanon since the 70's and they still are treated horribly. Just goes to show you how hypocritical the other Arab nations are when it comes to their support of Palestine and the Palestinian people. I had an Arabic teacher who was a Palestinian who lived in Jordan in a "camp". He worked for years to escape the refugee camp and finally was able to come to America. During his time there at the camp he became half blind due (supposedly) to their proximity to a Jordanian oil refinery plant. The Arabs don't care about Palestine or Palestinians. They are just using them.
Interesting. We'll see if it pans out! I know my old professor did not feel Jordanian in the slightest though he lived there for a grand long while. Thanks for the info!

You are welcome to join <Reliable Raiders> We are on PC/NA. We have 56+ plus player base. 300CP + Requirement and we use Discord. 30k + DPS parse on 3 mil dummy, Bis tank gear/skills/ultis etc (same for heals), are required for certification and upgrade in rank to "Raider" status.

&#x200B;

We initially were just a vet dlc hm focused guild for achievements/gear/titles/skins but because have have been growing so quickly we are now doing our first Trials together this Wednesday (nCR/gear runs) and Saturday (vet AA/hm attempt).  


Contact me @alarik83 for more infor/inv
